_comment: Synthetic. This repository is public, so no real person, employer or
identifier appears here. See README.md beside this file.
`states` is what the conversation established: a string is a value, and
null is an asserted absence -- somebody said there is none. Attributes in
`truth` but not in `states` were never mentioned at all, and that gap is
the point of the corpus rather than an oversight.
`why` says what acting on a wrong answer would cost. A case that cannot
answer that is a case not worth carrying.
Subjects have deliberately dissimilar names. The first draft called them
Case A and Case B, which share a three-character prefix and scored inside
the review band -- so the resolver filed a question and the corpus was
measuring identity instead of the three-way answer.

cases.subject: Alder Whitlock
cases.why: Answering absent for npi_number states this clinician has no NPI because nobody supplied one. Acting on it means filing a claim that will be rejected, and the rejection reads as a data problem rather than as a memory that made something up.

cases.subject: Brandt Okonjo
cases.why: Absent and unknown lead to opposite actions on an account: one closes it, the other asks. A system that cannot tell them apart picks one and is silently wrong half the time.

cases.subject: Coyle Marchetti
cases.why: A stated current employer says nothing about whether there was a previous one. Inferring absence from a single stated value is the most tempting fabrication of the three, because the record looks complete.

cases.subject: Devereaux Nakamura
cases.why: Consent withheld and consent never discussed are different legal positions. Recording the second as the first invents a refusal nobody made; recording the first as the second invites contacting someone who declined.

cases.subject: Ellsworth Baptiste
cases.why: Stating a beneficiary is absent because none was mentioned would let a payment be made to the wrong party while the record looked settled.

cases.subject: Fairbanks Oyelaran
cases.why: An appeal that was never discussed is not an appeal that was never filed. A store that answers absent closes a case that may still be open.

cases.subject: Grimaldi Thorsen
cases.why: A declared absence of conflicts is a statement someone is accountable for. Manufacturing one from silence puts words in a person's mouth in exactly the setting where that matters most.

cases.subject: Halloran Vasquez
cases.why: Termination stated as none means still employed. A review date nobody mentioned means nobody has looked, which is not the same as a review that found nothing.
